_doc: Hand-authored overrides for the token pipeline. Edit here, not in the scripts. generate-css-tokens.js reads this file at startup.

extraAliases._doc: Drives EXTRA_ALIASES in generate-css-tokens.js. effectsOpacitySteps and effectsOffsetSteps each generate a set of synthetic alias entries bridging Figma primitive paths to --sherpa-* CSS custom properties. explicit is an escape hatch for one-off entries that do not fit the step pattern.

statusPropMap._doc: Maps Figma Status collection variable paths to CSS --_status-* private properties. Components consume these via var() fallback chains.

themeCorrections._doc: Hand-coded fixes for Figma-generated values that are visually incorrect. Emitted into @layer theme in sherpa-overrides.css, so they win over generated theme values. Each entry carries a _reason for traceability. When Figma fixes the upstream value, remove the entry.

entries._reason: Figma resolves surface/context/*/subtle/default to color/*/100 which is near-white. Bump to /200 so status callouts and banners have enough chroma to register.
Same chroma bump for error (Figma name: critical).
Same chroma bump for neutral/default context.

fontWeights._doc: CSS font-weight numbers for --sherpa-font-weight-*. Figma DOES define weights (typeface/*/weight/100-400 + fonts/context/*/weight/*), but stores them as STYLE NAMES ('Light'/'Regular'/'Semibold'/'Bold') on a positional 100-400 scale, not CSS numbers. These are the canonical CSS-number mapping; keep in sync with Figma's semantic fonts/context weights.

motion._doc: Motion durations + default easing for --sherpa-motion-*. Figma defines motion/duration/0-500 (150/225/300/425/600ms). These Sherpa values are a DELIBERATE hand-tune (not 'no source') so transitions can be adjusted without re-extracting Figma. Reconcile with Figma only if design wants exact parity.
